notes.title: Page update :)
notes.content:
Hello!

I know that not everyone follows the development on our patreon. In this case, you may be surprised by the long development (considering the rest of our projects on Steam). This is our main project at the moment and it will be significantly larger than our other games, and, I hope, you will like it much more :)

Right now development is in full swing and today I have slightly updated the screenshots to a more recent state. I hope you will like it :)
